title: Build JakeAI Module Sandbox Engine
purpose: Create enforceable boundaries between the JakeAI core and independently developed product, game, social, content, integration, and internal-tool modules.
human_approval_record: User instructed 'Go' on 2026-09-11 to continue Module Sandbox Engine hardening and baseline-candidate work. This is not production, publication, checkout, spending, or commercial authorization.
unresolved_conditions: Exact candidate must pass change-control and module-sandbox gates plus compile, repository audit, and full regression suite before any baseline promotion.
evidence: Initial exact-head run correctly failed closed because modules/_template/module.json had no change-control classification.
A later run exposed cumulative change-request scope coupling; the engine was hardened so historical requests do not need to be rewritten for later scopes.
Module Sandbox then correctly blocked protected-core bootstrap changes; a narrow governed override contract was added and reviewed.
